_comment: Mutations that remove the guarantees added by the strategy-PnL fix:
the published PnL of a strategy must be its TRUE realized net, scoped to
its own config id and its own trading mode.
A is the ORIGINAL defect coming back: the publisher asks the RiskManager
ledger again, keyed by the strategy CLASS name. That ledger is keyed
(symbol, strategy_name), so the (None, class_name) lookup can never hit
and answers 0.0 for every strategy in every mode -- and it could not have
told two visual-builder strategies apart even if it had.
B is the trading mode not being consulted: the lookup takes whichever
book has a row, so a config id traded in paper AND live reports one of
the two numbers for both.
C is the sum forgetting the commission: the card would show the GROSS
result, and the user would be told the strategy earned money it never
earned.
D is the partial exits being counted as final exits. A PARTIAL row is a
real cash movement but it did not close a position, so counting it as
finalized double counts it against the strategy's realized result.
E is the owner filter being dropped, so another user's trades leak into
this user's strategy card.
F is the publisher going back to one query per strategy. The publisher
runs on a 2-second loop, so this is a query storm, not a rounding error.
G is an unreachable database publishing a false 0.0. A fake break-even is
exactly the lie this fix exists to remove.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/strategy_pnl_truth.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: A: the publisher asks the RiskManager ledger again, keyed by the class name
B: the trading mode is not consulted, so paper and live mix
C: the sum forgets the commission (gross instead of net)
D: the partial exits are counted as final exits
E: the owner filter is dropped, so another user's trades leak in
F: one query per strategy instead of one aggregate query
G: an unreachable database publishes a false 0.0
